name: Ardor3D PlyImporter
reason: JogAmp Javadoc documents a PlyImporter, but the tagged upstream Ardor3D 1.6.0 tree lacks that class; the documented JogAmp build is a 1.0-SNAPSHOT continuation. A pinned released artifact containing the importer and an ASCII control run remain unestablished.

name: ArtiSynth Maspack PlyReader
reason: The official 3.9 ZIP includes PlyReader source and compiled classes and a local-file API; a temporary control run parsed the ASCII triangle. However, its distribution LICENSE documents bundled TetGen restricted to noncommercial use. A separately released BSD-only Maspack PLY reader package has not been established, so the mixed-license distribution is not counted as an open-source package path.

name: JSplat jsplat-io-ply
reason: The publisher documents PlySplatReader.readList(InputStream) and the module depends on de.javagl:ply:0.0.4, sharing that underlying PLY reader family. The module POM is 0.0.1-SNAPSHOT, GitHub has no release tag, and no Maven Central release was found; a pinned open-source release and suitable ASCII Gaussian-splat control run are unestablished.

name: pcljava
reason: The README documents PointCloud3dReaderPly.read(local filename) over native PCL, but gives only 0.0.1-SNAPSHOT as a version and lists external PCL 1.11.1 native dependencies. The repository has no release tag or GitHub release, so a pinned released package, exact native graph, and ASCII control run are unestablished.

name: org.jorigin:jeometry-api 2.0.0 PLYReader
adoption_signal: deps.dev reported four known public direct dependents for exact Maven release 2.0.0 on 2026-11-13; excluded because the valid control did not parse.
reason: The tagged public PLYReader.read(File) called JeometryFactory.createPoint3DContainer, but the documented jeometry-simple implementation returns null from both container factory methods. On the valid ASCII triangle the reader threw IOException for the first vertex, caused by a null point container. The 1.0.5 tagged simple implementation has the same null methods. No format-aware control result was returned.

name: DirkToewe/sjmply
reason: GPL-3.0 repository documents PLY.load(Path) and property access, but GitHub exposes no tag or release; no pinned released library artifact or control run was established. This is a separate underlying parser lead.

name: cansik/pointcloud-processing PLYReader
reason: Tagged v0.2.0 reader wraps DirkToewe sjmply and has a local-file method, but the tagged tree has no license file and GitHub identifies no open-source license. No qualifying open-source package release or control result was established.
